info.name: Trabex Trade Compliance AES Filing Screening API

items.docs: Performs a real-time restricted party screening check against denied party lists, specially designated nationals (SDN), debarred lists, and embargoed country databases. Returns match results with risk scores and match details.
Performs restricted party screening for multiple parties in a single request. Ideal for bulk screening of customer lists, vendor databases, or order queues requiring simultaneous compliance checks.
